vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Master degree in Agricultural Microbiology/Basic and allied Microbiology/Biotechnology / other relevant basic science. Experience required: Desirable: a minimum of 02 years research experience in microbiological research, microbial diversity analysis / molecular microbial taxonomy and bioinformatics; experience in wet and dry lab studies. Age limit: 21 to 45 years. Pay: Rs. 30000.00 (consolidated). Qualification required: B.Sc. Microbiology/Basic Science or any related subjects or any relevant subject. Experience required: Desirable: minimum experience 06 months (Max. Limit of experience 5 years); experience in handling mycorrhizal/microbial cultures/plants. Age limit: Maximum 50 years. Pay: Rs. 20000.00 + HRA.

salary_details.pay_scale: YP-I: Rs. 30,000 per month (consolidated); Field Attendant: Rs. 20,000 per month + HRA

how_to_apply: Apply separately for each position on the proforma attached to the notice.
Email a self-attested, signed copy of the filled application with scanned self-attested copies of testimonials, certificates, age proof and mark-sheets.
Send it to [email protected]; [email protected] (also printed as [email protected]) by email only.
Send within 15 days from the date of publishing of the advertisement in newspapers; late applications are not considered.
Attend the walk-in interview on 17.11.2026 at 10.30 am with 2 copies of the application form, 2 self-attested copies of documents and all originals.
Email it on or before 27 November 2026.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The Director/PI reserved the right to cancel/postpone the interview without assigning any reason. Claims without documentary evidence will not be considered; incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Concealing of facts/canvassing shall lead to disqualification. Keep checking the Institute website for further information or corrigendum regarding the interview. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Jodhpur Court only.

Experience required: Desirable: a minimum of 02 years research experience in microbiological research, microbial diversity analysis / molecular microbial taxonomy and bioinformatics; experience in wet and dry lab studies. Age limit: 21 to 45 years. Pay: Rs. 30000.00 (consolidated). Qualification required: B.Sc. Microbiology/Basic Science or any related subjects or any relevant subject. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary, contractual engagement under the project. YP initial engagement one year, extendable for two more years (01 year at a time) subject to requirement and satisfactory performance. Field Attendant for 12 months or until termination of the project, whichever is earlier; position renewed every six months based on performance. Positions can be terminated with one month's notice owing to any change in circumstances. No right to claim employment or engagement in ICAR at the end of the contract period.

content_sections.heading: How Will ICAR-CAZRI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Original documents are verified at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form strictly in the given format (all fields mandatory) and complete CV Class 10 and Class 12 mark sheets and pass certificates Graduation and Post-Graduation mark sheets/transcripts and degree certificates Experience Certificate and No-Objection Certificate (if currently employed), as and where applicable Conversion factor from CGPA to percentage; PhD degree certificate and marksheet, where applicable SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer/PH certificate as applicable; copy of publication if any

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The Director/PI reserved the right to cancel/postpone the interview without assigning any reason.
